description: Tests for anomaly detection thresholds differentiating routine communications from genuine burst events. Robustness category N.

fixtures.input_condition: A routine single call log versus a burst communication pattern of 18 calls within two hours

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Routine communication: +91-9876543210 called +91-9123456789 once for 2 minutes.
TEST FIXTURE: Burst calling pattern detected: +91-9876543210 made 18 calls within 2 hours.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Anomaly detector triggers high-frequency burst alert only on textual indicator or statistical event count surpassing threshold >= 5.
fixtures.rationale: Regex search on 'burst' or call frequency threshold filters routine single interactions.
